title: Broiler.Documents external corpus sources
description: The register a document written outside this repository has to pass through before the corpus suite may read it. It exists so the answer to 'where did this test document come from' is a row with a decision, a permitted use, a licence and a digest, rather than a URL somebody pasted. Modelled on docs/pdf-approved-sources.md, which does the same job for implementation sources, and on tests/pdf/tools/manifest.json, which does it for executables. The suite ships with an empty sources array, so it fetches nothing.

policy.description: Prose, and load-bearing prose. The insufficient list is required because every argument on it has been made somewhere in good faith, and a register that only says what is enough leaves the reader to infer the rest.

sources.description: One row per external document. An empty array is the shipped state and means the suite is fully hermetic.

licence.description: The instrument by name, not a characterisation of it. 'Permissive' is not a licence.

permittedUse.description: What this project may do with the document, which is usually narrower than what the licence allows. Reading it in a test is not the same permission as redistributing it in an artifact.

decision.description: Only `approved` is fetched. `pending` is the honest state for a row somebody added but nobody decided, and the runner reports it as pending rather than skipping it quietly.

reviewer.description: A person. Null only while the decision is pending.

sha256.description: Pinned bytes. Null only while the decision is pending; an approved row without one is rejected by the runner, because a fetch nobody pinned is a test whose input can change under it.
